description: This file defines a Smarty plugin function called smarty_modifier_regex_replace, which performs a regular expression search and replace on a given string. It specifically implements the regex_replace modifier for the Smarty templating engine, enabling regex-based string replacements within templates.

methods.name: smarty_modifier_regex_replace
methods.description: Performs a regex search and replace on an input string, with handling for eval-modifiers to prevent code execution when matching certain patterns.
